title: smtp/relay_client.rs: rustls RootCertStore rebuilt on every TLS connection
description:
Why this issue exists: In crates/smtp/src/relay_client.rs, tls_wrap builds a new RootCertStore and ClientConfig on every outbound SMTP TLS connection. Building the root store requires loading and parsing all webpki root certificates each time, which is unnecessary repeated work.

What needs to be done: Construct the Arc<ClientConfig> once (e.g. in a LazyLock or in SmtpRelayQueue initialization) and reuse it across connections.
